description: After the main-based benchmark harness is implemented, run its full suite on main and save a documented JSON baseline. Integrate the harness branch into target-agnostic-substrate without merging the PR into main. Run identical inputs/configuration/toolchain on substrate. Produce a comparison with ratios and deterministic diff/message counts; distinguish benchmark-process memory from server-process resource use. Check that metadata and fixture signatures match before comparing. Preserve any findings in follow-up bw issues with reproductions and specific implementation instructions; do not silently omit failing scenarios or tune one branch differently. Push both branches and verify CI.
title: Record main baseline then compare the same harness on substrate
